verdict.rationale: Mercury documents setting and managing card/spend limits (mercury-docs-10, mercury-docs-36, mercury-docs-52) and approval-gated money movement (mercury-docs-47, mercury-docs-55), but there is no evidence of a self-service screen specifically for a finance-lead to *request* a transaction limit *increase* (e.g., an increase workflow with review/approval for existing limits). Limit controls shown are admin-configured, not a request-for-increase flow.
